integrations.pageDescription: Every provider SDP can run for this organization, with what is connected and what to do next. Custody installs from Wallets; other families are provisioned per deployment.
integrations.custodyDescription: Wallet infrastructure and signing. Install from the wallet setup flow.
integrations.rpcDescription: Solana RPC for this organization. One provider serves at a time; open a provider to add your own key, switch to it, or test the connection.
integrations.rampsDescription: Onramp and offramp rails used by deposits and payouts.
integrations.complianceDescription: Screening and monitoring providers. Enabled per organization by arrangement.
integrations.privacyDescription: Privacy infrastructure configured per project for private execution and settlement.
integrations.privateChannelsDescription: Private balances, transfers, and settlement through a connected Solana Private Channels instance.
integrations.privateChannelsConnectPrompt: Connect a Private Channels instance to enable this workspace.
integrations.privateChannelsUnavailable: Connection status is unavailable right now. You can still open setup and retry.
integrations.custodyUnavailable: Custody connection state is unavailable right now. Reload to see what is installed before setting anything up.
integrations.emptyBody: Try a different search or clear the filters.
integrations.rpcActiveHere: This organization's RPC traffic runs through this provider.
integrations.rpcActiveOverridden: This organization is set to this provider, but this project runs on your own {provider} connection instead.
integrations.rpcActiveOwnCredential: This project runs on your own connection with this provider, not on SDP's account.
integrations.rpcServedByProject: This project runs on your own {provider} connection.
integrations.rpcSwitchedToOwnKey: Now serving from your own {provider} key.
integrations.rpcNotConfiguredHere: This deployment holds no endpoint for this provider, so it cannot be selected here.
integrations.rpcActiveSelectedOnly: This organization is set to use this provider.
integrations.rpcActiveUnavailable: This deployment no longer holds an endpoint for this provider, so RPC traffic is falling back to another one.
integrations.rampMoonpayDescription: Card and bank fiat onramp and offramp.
integrations.rampLightsparkDescription: Fiat settlement rails over the Lightning Network.
integrations.rampBvnkDescription: Business payments between fiat and stablecoins.
integrations.rampMoneygramDescription: Cash and bank transfers through the MoneyGram network.
integrations.rampCoinbaseDescription: Fiat onramp and offramp through Coinbase accounts.
integrations.complianceRangeDescription: Transaction screening and risk monitoring for Solana.
integrations.connectSelfServe: Connect this provider yourself using credentials from your own account. Secrets are write-only and never shown again after submission.
integrations.connectByArrangement: Available by arrangement. The SDP team grants access and sets up the connection with your organization.
integrations.connectManaged: Provisioned per deployment. This provider is configured by your SDP operator rather than self-serve.
integrations.rpcByokDescription: Route this project's RPC through an account you own. Keys are encrypted and never shown again.
integrations.rpcByokEndpointHint: Your account's endpoint. If the key goes inside the URL, mark the spot with the placeholder below.
integrations.rpcByokApiKeyHint: Sent once and stored encrypted. Saving checks it against the provider straight away.
integrations.rpcByokEmpty: No credentials of your own yet. This organization is running on SDP's.
integrations.rpcByokEmptyRoutedElsewhere: No credentials for this provider. This project runs on your own {provider} connection.
integrations.rpcByokAdminOnly: Only organization administrators can add credentials.
integrations.rpcByokUnavailable: Your own credentials could not be loaded just now. Reload before assuming there are none.
integrations.rpcByokRestricted: Only organization administrators can see the credentials stored here.
integrations.rpcByokOrganizationScoped: Set up for the whole organization. Connections belong to a project now, so this one is not routing traffic. Add it again on the project that needs it.
integrations.rpcByokDeactivatedMeaning: Withdrawn. The stored key was destroyed, so this connection cannot be brought back. Add a new one to route through your own provider again.
integrations.rpcByokLastActive: Withdrawing this key puts this project back on SDP's account.
integrations.rpcByokLastActiveByok: This organization runs only on its own credentials, so withdrawing this key stops RPC instead of falling back to SDP's.
integrations.rpcByokServingHasSpare: Withdrawing this key will not hand over to your other keys. Switch to the provider you want first.
integrations.rpcByokDeleteConfirm: Delete this connection? Its key was destroyed when it was deactivated, so this only clears the record.
integrations.rpcModeTitle: Run entirely on your own credentials
integrations.rpcModeToggle: Run entirely on your own credentials
integrations.rpcModeManagedHint: SDP's providers answer for any project without a connection of its own. Turn this on once every project you use has one.
integrations.rpcModeByokHint: SDP's providers will not answer for this organization. A project without a live connection fails instead of falling back to our keys.
integrations.rpcModeStranded: Nothing is serving. Every RPC call for this organization is failing until a connection is added, or until this is switched back off.
integrations.rpcByokOnlyOne: This provider already holds a key for this project. Rotate it above to replace it, or deactivate it to start over.
integrations.rpcByokAddAlongside: Your own {provider} connection is serving this project. Add a key here and you can switch to it whenever you want; traffic keeps running on {provider} until you do.
integrations.rpcByokRotateHint: The connection keeps serving on the current key until the new one has been checked. If the new key is rejected, nothing changes.
